ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde human reviewer (trust & safety): review chat log F8 ("Shut up and let me drive") as a suspected Code of Conduct breach and rider's "felt unsafe" statement; hold the route-deviation fare review (RD-2 estimate ~$5.29 in extra metered distance) pending the human outcome. Notify rider of RydeHELP reporting path.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1 Code of Conduct screen triggered: driver's in-trip message F8 is a direct verbal attack/harassment of the rider, plus a rider safety allegation. Per SAFE-1 no automatic ruling is issued; factual summary (deviation F3 +3.75 km unexempted, provisional RD-2 amount $5.28) is referred to a human reviewer.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 08:58–09:05 (+3.75 km, up to 1034 m from the optimal route) is not exempt: RD-4 requires a DataMall traffic incident on the substituted optimal route (F13: none), and F11/F12 are speed-band 4 records which under RD-4(b) are corroborative only; RD-5 consent fails because the only chat messages (F7 rider challenge, F8 driver reply, all timestamped per F9) contain no rider agreement before 08:58, and the driver's GPS explanation (F10) is a post-trip claim, not consent (G11); RD-3 shows no passenger-named stop or destination change. Under RD-1 the segment is an unexempted detour.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip written statement ("I followed my GPS; it rerouted me. Nothing wrong with the fare") — a statement, not a system record, and it is contradicted by the GPS/timeline facts F1/F3; it also does not meet RD-4 (no incident on the optimal route, F13) or RD-5 (no pre-detour rider consent).

Speed-band 4 (30–39 km/h) on PIE/KPE cannot exempt the segment: RD-4(b) makes band records corroborative only and only bands 1–2 evidence serious congestion, and these are not even on the substituted optimal segment.
